honey chipotle chicken sandwiches ✨ i will be uploading a newer version of my bun recipe because i tweaked it a bit to make them even softer!  Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Refrigerate for 3 hours minimum or overnight for best results. - Combine all dredge ingredients. Drizzle a little of the marinade into the flour and toss with spoon create those crispy, craggy pieces. - Remove chicken from the marinade and coat well in the dredge. Dip it back into the marinade, then into the dredge again, pressing the flour mixture firmly onto the chicken. Let the double-battered chicken rest for 10–12 minutes so the coating sticks. - Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches until deeply golden and crispy and the center reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. - For the honey chipotle sauce, add honey, blended chipotle peppers, butter, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt to a saucepan. Heat on low for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and glossy. - Brush or drizzle the warm honey chipotle sauce over the freshly fried chicken. - Toast your brioche buns, add ranch, pickles, crispy honey chipotle chicken, and serve immediately.  • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenrecipe #sandwich

Ingredients: 1 tbsp salted butter 1 can (14oz)sweetened condensed milk  2/3 cup sweetened coconut flakes  Sugar coating: 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tbsp vinegar  How to: In a sauce pan add butter and turn it on medium heat until melted. Next add in sweetened condensed milk and coconut flakes. Stir on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until the mixture is thickened and can pull away from the pan. Add it into a separate bowl and place in the refrigerator until cooled.  Once cooled, take a tbsp of the mixture and roll it between greased hands to form a ball and place it onto a parchment lined pan until all of the mixture is formed into bite sized balls. Next in a sauce, pan, combine sugar, water, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, until it turns amber in color. Take off the heat. Next insert a toothpick into each ball and dip it into the amber sugar and place back onto a parchment lined pan.  Let cool and serve! #dessert #coconut #balabaiana #easyrecipe #recipeshare

Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder. Cook 1–2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce jalapeños and water. Simmer uncovered 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has completely reduced and the beef is moist but not watery. Taste and adjust salt if needed. Remove from heat and cool slightly. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickles, pickle juice, onion, garlic powder, smoked paprika, sugar and black pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out the tortillas and spread about 1 tbsp sauce slightly below the center. Add about 1/4 cup beef, 2 tbsp cheese, caramelized onions and pickled jalapeños. Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place wraps seam-side down and cook 2–3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and crispy. Continue cooking until all sides are crisp and the cheese is melted. Rest 1–2 minutes, slice in half and serve immediately with extra cheeseburger sauce.  #recipe #cheeseburger

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. videos.caption: Crockpot Mongolian Beef & Noodles 🥩🍜🔥 Crockpot Series Episode 7: Mongolian Beef & Noodles This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you’ve got. Tender chuck roast, a sweet and savory Mongolian-style sauce, and noodles coated in all that flavor. We sear the beef for extra color, then the crockpot does the work and you take the credit! 🙌🏽🔥 Ingredients: 2 pounds thinly sliced chuck roast 4 tablespoons butter, for searing 1 cup low-sodium shoyu 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup low-sodium beef broth 2 tablespoons minced garlic 1 tablespoon grated ginger 2 tablespoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 1 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons cornstarch 2 tablespoons cold water 12 ounces precooked lo mein noodles. I used yakisoba noodles brand is Fortune. Sliced green onions Sesame seeds, optional Instructions: 1. Season your beef with SPG or your favorite seasoning. Heat a skillet over high heat with the butter and sear the beef in small batches for 1-2 minutes per side. You’re building color, not cooking it through. 2. Transfer the beef to the crockpot. Deglaze the skillet with a splash of the measured beef broth, scrape up those browned bits, and pour everything into the crockpot. 3. Add the remaining broth, shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and black pepper. Stir gently. 4. Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or HIGH for 2.5 to 3.5 hours. Start checking early so the thin beef stays tender without falling apart. 5. Mix the cornstarch slurry with a cup of broth. Stir the slurry into the sauce and cook on HIGH for 15–20 minutes, until thick and glossy. 6. Slice the green onions into 1 inch piece. Separate the precooked noodles and add them directly to the crockpot. Toss everything together and heat on HIGH for 5–10 minutes. 7. Finish with sliced green onions, sesame seeds, and chili crisp oil if you want some heat then serve immediately. Don’t leave those noodles sitting on KEEP WARM—they’ll keep drinking up the sauce. Save this one for an easy weeknight dinner! 🍜🔥 #crockpotrecipes #crockpot #EasyRecipe #hawaiitiktok #mongolianbeef

Arayes 🥙 This is one of the best Mediterranean meals you can easily make at home in about 30 minutes. Crispy pita stuffed with seasoned beef, cooked until golden, and finished with a creamy garlic sauce. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, grated onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until fully combined and slightly sticky. 3. Cut the pitas in half and gently open each pocket (heat the pitas in the microwave for a few seconds first to make them easier to open). Spread a thin layer of the meat mixture inside each pita, then brush the outside generously with olive oil. 4. Heat a pan over medium heat. Cook the arayes meat side down first for 1–2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat reaches 155°F internally. 6. While the arayes cook, mix together all sauce ingredients until smooth. 7. Brush the hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley, then serve with the dipping sauce. #easydinners #arayes #pita

Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. Recipe Name: Slow Cooker Creamy Garlic Parmesan Pork Chops Ingredients 1. 4 bone-in pork chops 2. 1 tsp salt 3. 1/2 tsp black pepper 4. 1 tsp garlic powder 5. 1 tsp onion powder 6. 1 tbsp olive oil 7. 3 tbsp butter 8. 4 cloves garlic, minced 9. 1 cup chicken broth 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 13. 1/2 tsp paprika 14. 1 tbsp cornstarch 15. 2 tbsp water 16. 2 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels. 2. Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Sear the pork chops for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown. 5. Transfer the pork chops to a slow cooker. 6. In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté the garlic for 30 seconds. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up any browned bits from the pan. 8. Stir in the heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, and Italian seasoning. 9. Pour the creamy mixture over the pork chops in the slow cooker. 10. Cover and cook on LOW for 5–6 hours or HIGH for 2½–3 hours. 11. Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl until smooth. 12. Stir the slurry into the slow cooker during the last 20 minutes of cooking. 13. Let the sauce thicken while the pork chops finish cooking. 14. Spoon the creamy garlic Parmesan sauce over the pork chops. 15. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving. 16. Serve hot with mashed potatoes, rice, or roasted vegetables. Crispy Chicken Alfredo Burritos 🌯🍗 These crispy chicken Alfredo burritos are the ultimate comfort food! Juicy seasoned chicken, creamy homemade Alfredo sauce, melted mozzarella and a crunchy cornflake coating, all wrapped in a golden, crispy tortilla. #chickenalfredo #chickenburrito #easyrecipes #chickenwrap #dinnerideas  Ingredients: For the chicken * 600g chicken breasts * 1 tsp black pepper * 1 tbsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tbsp smoked paprika * Salt to taste * 2 tbsp olive oil, for marinating * Oil, for cooking For the creamy Alfredo sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 1 tbsp garlic, minced * 1 cup double cream/heavy cream * 1/2 cup cream cheese * 1 cup Parmesan cheese, grated * Salt to taste * 1 tsp chicken bouillon * 1 tsp black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp oregano * 1 tsp chilli flakes To assemble * 6 large flour tortillas * 1 cup mozzarella cheese For the crispy coating * 2 large eggs, beaten * 2 cups cornflakes, crushed * Oil, for frying Method 1. Marinate the chicken: Season the chicken breasts with black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and smoked paprika. Add the olive oil and coat well. Marinate for 30 minutes–1 hour. 2. Cook the chicken: Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the chicken on both sides until golden and cooked through. Remove, rest for a few minutes, then chop into bite-sized pieces. 3. Make the Alfredo sauce: In the same pan, melt the butter and sauté the garlic for about 30 seconds. Add the cream, cream cheese, chicken bouillon, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, oregano and chilli flakes. Stir until smooth. 4. Add the Parmesan: Reduce the heat and stir in the Parmesan until melted and creamy. Simmer for 2–3 minutes until the sauce thickens. Let it cool slightly. 5. Assemble the burritos: Place a tortilla flat and add Alfredo sauce, mozzarella, chicken, more Alfredo sauce and mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. 6. Coat: Dip each burrito into the beaten egg, then coat generously with crushed cornflakes, pressing gently so they stick. 7. Fry until crispy: Heat oil over medium heat. Place the burritos seam-side down first and fry on all sides until deeply golden, crispy and the cheese is melted. 8. Serve: Drain on a wire rack or paper towel and let them rest for 2–3 minutes before cutting.

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Let’s make Texas Fudge! Texas Fudge Ingredients Cheese Mixture 16 oz shredded sharp cheddar cheese 16 oz shredded Monterey Jack cheese 8 slices cooked bacon, chopped ½ cup chopped pickled jalapeños Liquid Mixture 1 (15 oz) can evaporated milk 2 large eggs ½ cup all-purpose flour Instructions 1. Prepare the Cheese Base In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded sharp cheddar, shredded Monterey Jack, chopped bacon, and chopped pickled jalapeños. Mix everything together thoroughly and set aside. 2. Make the Liquid Batter In a separate bowl, whisk together the evaporated milk and eggs until well combined. Add the all-purpose flour and whisk until the mixture is smooth and no lumps remain. 3. Combine & Mix Pour the liquid mixture into the cheese mixture. Stir well until everything is evenly coated and fully combined. 4. Bake Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease a 9x13 baking pan. Pour the mixture into the prepared pan and spread evenly. Bake for 35–40 minutes, or until the top is golden and the center is set. 5. Cool & Serve Allow the Texas Fudge to cool completely before cutting. If you cut it too early, it will not hold its shape. Slice into squares and enjoy!🤠❤️😘#fyp #texasfudge #viralvideo #recipe #nannychelle

Loaded Layered Fiesta Taco Salad Trifle Bowl A delicious, colorful, and protein-packed Mexican-inspired layered salad! 🥗 Ingredients For the Beef Layer: 500g ground beef 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp taco seasoning ½ tsp garlic powder Salt & black pepper For the Creamy Dressing: 1 cup sour cream ½ cup mayonnaise or Greek yogurt 2 tbsp lime juice 1 tsp taco seasoning For the Salad Layers: 2 cups crushed tortilla chips 1 cup cooked seasoned ground beef 1 cup shredded lettuce 1 cup diced tomatoes 1 cup diced bell peppers 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 1 avocado, diced ½ cup chopped fresh cilantro ½ cup diced red onion 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Cook the Beef Heat olive oil in a pan. Add ground beef, taco seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Cook until browned. Let it cool slightly. 2. Prepare the Dressing Mix sour cream, mayonnaise or Greek yogurt, lime juice, and taco seasoning until smooth and creamy. 3. Layer the Salad In a large glass trifle bowl, arrange the ingredients in layers: 1. Crushed tortilla chips 2. Seasoned ground beef 3. Creamy dressing 4. Diced bell peppers 5. Shredded lettuce 6. Diced tomatoes 7. Creamy dressing 8. Shredded cheddar cheese 9. Diced avocado 10. Fresh cilantro and tomatoes on top 4. Chill & Serve Refrigerate for 20–30 minutes. Serve fresh, and enjoy this beautiful layered taco salad! ⏱️ Prep Time: 20 minutes 🍳 Cook Time: 15 minutes 🍽️ Servings: 6–8 💡 Tip: Add black beans, corn, or jalapeños for extra flavor. For the best crunch, add tortilla chips just before serving.
